name: maud_legal_bench
description: A legal-domain subset in the MTEB suite designed to evaluate embedding and retrieval quality on legal texts. It measures how well models capture semantic similarity, relevance, and ranking for legal queries and documents. Typically used to benchmark embedding models and semantic search systems in the legal / regulatory domain.
reputation: Part of the MTEB benchmark collection and recognized for evaluating embeddings in specialized legal text retrieval tasks.
